why: This is Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture; the conjecture remains open. A 2019 preprint (arXiv:1912.00541, 'All groups are surjunctive') is pre-snapshot and not accepted as resolving it. Post-snapshot papers found (2025 non-uniform cellular automata, 2025 invariant random subgroups/cosoficity) are about variants and generalizations, not the core conjecture itself, and the Wikipedia article still states no non-surjunctive group has been found.
